resources.string: Fill the frame with a single leaf. Avoid whole-plant shots.

Signs consistent with bacterial infection. Remove and destroy affected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and sanitise tools between plants. Confirm with your local agriculture officer before applying any treatment.

Signs consistent with fungal infection. Improve spacing and airflow, keep foliage dry, and clear fallen debris around the plant. Confirm with your local agriculture officer before applying any treatment.
No disease indicators detected in this leaf. Continue routine monitoring, especially on new growth and leaf undersides.

Signs consistent with pest damage. Inspect leaf undersides and stems for insects or eggs. Note: this app performs poorly on pest damage under field conditions — treat this result as a prompt to inspect, not as a diagnosis.
Signs consistent with viral infection. Viral disease cannot be cured; isolate or remove affected plants, control insect vectors, and sanitise tools. Confirm with your local agriculture officer.
The image is unclear or cannot be confidently identified. Please take a closer, well-lit photo of the affected chili leaf.
This does not appear to be a chili plant leaf. Please capture a valid chili leaf.
This image could not be opened. Please choose another.
Research prototype. Accuracy degrades on distant or whole-plant photographs. Not a substitute for professional agronomic advice.
Capsibus requires camera access to capture leaf images for on-device diagnosis. You can also select photos from your gallery.
